summary: Native Windows, fully-offline local generation via onnxruntime-genai. Subprocess shape (not HTTP): PIE shells out to a local Python helper.

deterministic_replay.note: Greedy decode (do_sample off, temperature 0) reduces variance but does not guarantee cross-host bit reproduction; the packet binds output to the sealed model set and host/time.
